research_question: Do the preregistered M00-M04 analytic reference identities satisfy independent numeric implementations without physical SST target fitting?
objective: Qualify source provenance, a steady-Euler toroidal reference, pressure silence, VA/VT projection, and a spherical local-flux identity.
null_hypothesis: Analytic/numeric agreement alone does not demonstrate any stable particle, gravity or dynamic 3D Euler knot; scientific certification needs native and independent evidence.
alternative_hypothesis: A subsequent physical SST claim may be entertained only after independently produced 3D Euler fields pass native and dynamical qualification; not tested here.
assumptions: 3D trace-free local velocity gradient in tested algebraic controls
Landreman field is dimensionless and evaluated strictly inside its smooth toroidal domain
Pressure Q_L is kinematic Euler pressure, distinct from MHD pressure
Chiarini force is projected to divergence-free vorticity sector
Zhang-Yao affine-flow identity does not extend without remainder to turbulent fields
No physical SST constants are used in blind scoring

symbols.meaning: scale energy transfer per unit mass

observables.definition: M01 maximum normalized momentum and pressure residuals

steps.operation: Validate SHA256 of original reference PDFs and explicitly log A045 registry mismatch
Evaluate Landreman analytic field and central differences; compare momentum, divergence and pressure source
Compute Q,R,Schur fraction f and m on analytic and seeded trace-free tensors
Use periodic FFT Poisson projection, compare curl force with -PVA, integrate correction
Integrate exact affine velocity increments on sphere and compare with gradient-flux identity

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any analytic tensor identity violates its pre-registered numerical tolerance

falsification_criteria.conclusion_if_met: FAIL source integrity; stop formal freeze

edge_cases: omega=0 -> VA projector undefined unless masked
Landreman s=0 or F<=0 outside admissible analytic region
FFT zero/Nyquist mode needs explicit convention
General nonlinear flows retain higher spherical modes
Registry mismatch A045 must be resolved before source independence certification
predictions: Analytic Euler residuals converge under finite-difference refinement
Pressure source cancels in balanced vortex despite nonzero VA
Projected VA force differs locally from bare -VA
Spherical quadrature exactly reproduces the L=1 gradient flux for affine fields
